description: This PHP source file defines the class ParserSearchFields, which extends ModuleBuilderParser. It manages search field configurations for modules within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework, allowing addition, removal, retrieval, and saving of search fields, with support for package-specific and default module metadata.

classes.name: ParserSearchFields
classes.description: A parser class responsible for handling search fields metadata for modules, supporting both package-based and default module configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with module and optional package names, and loads the current search fields.

methods.name: addSearchField
methods.description: Adds a new search field to the internal searchFields array, scoped by package and module.

methods.name: removeSearchField
methods.description: Removes a specified search field from the internal searchFields array.

methods.name: getSearchFields
methods.description: Loads and returns the search fields from the appropriate metadata file, considering package context.

methods.name: saveSearchFields
methods.description: Persists the current search fields to the proper metadata file, creating directories as required.
